mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% signals robust residential construction demand, which correlates with rising consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST shows month-over-month growth > 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 0.5% and shows a rising trend (3-month rate of change > 0.05% per month), it signals tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising (3-month rate of change > 0.05% per month)
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and margins, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 3.0% year-over-year (CPIAUCSL) signals central bank tightening pressure, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when YoY CPIAUCSL > 3.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 3.5% indicates strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth > 3.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad-based consumer demand strength, boosting corporate revenue visibility and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% with downward momentum (3-month change < -0.2%) signals labor market recovery, increasing consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% and declining over a 3-year rolling window.
